extracted.intended_audience: general readers and Wikipedia editors interested in Steven Crowder / political commentary
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic biographical entry about political commentator Steven Crowder on English Wikipedia, covering early life, career, controversies, filmography, and references; includes Wikipedia maintenance/metadata categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: All articles lacking reliable references
rubrics_metrics.description: All articles lacking reliable references; Articles lacking reliable references from February 2025
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article is flagged as lacking reliable sources — claims should be supported by citations to reliable, verifiable sources. Editors should add high-quality references or remove unsourced material.

rubrics_metrics.name: All pages needing factual verification
rubrics_metrics.description: All pages needing factual verification; Wikipedia articles needing factual verification from September 2025
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements in the article require verification. Use inline citations to authoritative sources; tag statements that cannot be verified and correct or remove content that can't be sourced.

rubrics_metrics.name: All articles with unsourced statements
rubrics_metrics.description: All articles with unsourced statements; Articles with unsourced statements from January 2023
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any factual claim lacking a citation should be marked (e.g., {{citation needed}}), sourced with reliable references, or removed. Ensure biographical details, especially contentious or potentially libelous material, are well-sourced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use American English
rubrics_metrics.description: Use American English from March 2013; All Wikipedia articles written in American English
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow American English spelling and style conventions throughout the article (e.g., 'color' not 'colour') as per the site's language-use guideline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use mdy dates
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format dates using month-day-year (e.g., July 7, 1987) consistently within the article and infobox, following the site's date-format guideline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short description consistency with Wikidata
rubrics_metrics.description: Short description is different from Wikidata
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the article's short description matches or is consistent with the corresponding Wikidata entry; resolve discrepancies between the short description and Wikidata to avoid confusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid deprecated infobox parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Pages using infobox person with deprecated parameters
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Update the infobox to use current/accepted parameters and templates; remove or replace deprecated parameters to conform with template documentation and site standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include authority control identifiers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where applicable, include authority control identifiers (e.g., MusicBrainz, VIAF, etc.) in the article to aid identification and linking to library/authority databases.
